segments.name: Synthetic DNA products
segments.description: Manufactures synthetic DNA products, NGS tools and biopharma antibody discovery services for researchers, biotech, pharma, chemical and agricultural customers.
segments.evidence: We have one reportable segment from the manufacturing of synthetic DNA products.

revenueModel.text: Customers in healthcare, chemicals/materials, academic research and food/agriculture pay for synthetic genes, oligo pools, DNA libraries, NGS tools and antibody discovery services.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our products and services to a global customer base of more than 3,800, customers across a broad range of industries.

changes.text: In fiscal 2025 the company sold its DNA digital data storage business, reducing research and development costs.
changes.evidence: This reduction is primarily attributed to lower personnel costs of $4.9 million and a decrease in stock-based compensation expense of $2.2 million, both driven by the sale of DNA digital data storage business.
